title: Constructed tensor restriction comparisons
statement: For a commuting open square j;U inclusion = U prime inclusion;k, construct the underived tensor restriction isomorphism from the pinned tensor adjunctions and tensor composition comparisons. Whisker it with the single functor and the exact single restriction comparison to obtain the derived target isomorphism. Also apply the termwise homotopy construction to obtain the homotopy tensor restriction isomorphism. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps].

lean.statement: def openPinnedSingleTargetRestrictionIso [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme) (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k) : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0) ⋙ (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory ≅ schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U'.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0
